name: How do property taxes differ for golf course homes in Florida?

mainEntity.name: How do property taxes differ for golf course homes in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property taxes for homes in golf course communities in Florida are assessed based on the property's market value, similar to other residential properties. There isn't a specific separate tax rate for golf course homes. However, the desirable location, larger lot sizes, and premium amenities often found in these communities can result in higher property valuations, leading to higher property tax bills compared to homes in less amenity-rich areas. This cost consideration is important to factor into your overall budget, particularly in high-value areas like Coral Gables or Fort Lauderdale Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property taxes for golf course homes are based on market value, similar to other properties. Higher valuations due to amenities and location often lead to higher tax bills.
